column1: # The hospital's senior and administrative staff, as the press and archives name them.
# Hand-curated from the readings behind paper/hospital-history.html — NOT scraped.
# Each row cites a source in data/public/sources-registry.json that actually names
# the person in that post; where a source only fixes a date approximately the
# `from`/`to` columns say so by being equal or blank rather than by guessing.
# kind: post   a named administrative office (director, deputy, senior MO)
#       staff  a named physician without an administrative post
# certainty: stated    the source names the post in so many words
#            inferred  the post is deduced across sources (say why in `note`)
# same_as: the MidEastMed person node when the press and the prosopography
#          name the SAME person. The row is then merged onto that person
#          rather than drawn twice, and they carry both evidence marks.
#          Only fill this where the identification is secure.
# Columns: name, name_ar, post, kind, from, to, certainty, source, same_as, note
name
Dr A. Malchi
column3: Government physician, Haifa district; district forensic examiner; director by 1945
column10: Transferred from Safed to the Government Hospital, Oct 1931. The directorship by 1945 is deduced across the readings, not stated in one source.

column1: Dr Naif Amin Hamzeh
column3: Physician; Medical Officer; director at the end
column10: Hon. M.B.E. in the 1943 Birthday Honours as Medical Officer. Named director of the hospital at the handover, 28 Apr 1948; left for Lebanon.

column1: Dr Haddad
column10: Gave evidence with Dr N. Hamzeh as "physicians of the Government Hospital" at the trial over the 1 May 1936 Haifa disturbances.

column1: Dr Y. Shapira
column10: Opened a discussion on sanitary and hygienic questions in industry for the Manufacturers' Association.

column1: Colonel Heron
column10: Departmental, not hospital: read Mendelsohn's letter at the opening. Replaced by Mc-Cowen by Nov 1939.

column1: Dr J. H. Thomson
column10: Named as supervising the staff at the move to Bat Galim, Nov 1938.

column1: Dr McCowen
column3: Director, Haifa health department and of the hospital
column10: Leaves Nov 1939 to be Deputy Director of the Department of Health, and its Director by 1944. The Nov 1939 farewell prints the name unreadably; the Apr 1944 Tel Aviv debate resolves it.

column1: Dr M. K. M. Mishalany
column10: Showed Field Marshal Lord Gort round the hospital with the Matron. Left Dec 1945 to direct the Government Hospital in Nablus.

column1: Dr Ibrahim Isa'is
column10: Appointed from Nablus in place of Dr Mishlani, began work 10 Dec 1945.

column1: Dr Laufer
column3: Specialist surgeon; surgeon and deputy director
column10: A specialist surgeon who served in the British army during the war.

column1: Dr Tahuian
column10: Physician of the Government Hospital, giving medical evidence in court.

column1: Dr MacNeil
column3: British chief physician at the handover
column10: Present at the transfer of the hospital to the municipality, 2 May 1948.
